title: Task Evaluation Configuration
description: Defines the evaluation plan for a task across multiple subjects and optional cross-stack checks.

constraints.description: Enabled constraint rule IDs for this scope.

metrics.description: Enabled metric rule IDs for this scope.

judgments.description: Enabled judgment rule IDs for this scope.

thresholdMap.description: Threshold configuration keyed by metric rule ID.

subject_id.description: Stable identifier for this evaluation subject, e.g. backend or frontend.

root_path.description: Workspace-relative path to the subject root.

rulepack_version.description: Optional version pin for the selected rulepack.

expected_diff_scope.description: Allowed file globs for modifications within this subject.

metadata.description: Optional subject-scoped metadata for auditing or experimentation.

rulepack_id.description: Cross-stack rulepack selected for contract checks across subjects.

rulepack_version.description: Optional version pin for the cross-stack rulepack.

expected_diff_scope.description: Allowed file globs for cross-stack modifications.

schema_version.description: Schema version for the task configuration document.

task_version.description: Version of the evaluation task definition.

description.description: Human-readable description of the evaluation task.

subjects.description: Evaluation subjects processed independently by the orchestrator.

model.description: LLM model identifier used for judgment runs.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature for the LLM judge.

samples_per_rubric.description: Number of repeated samples collected for each rubric.

min_kappa.description: Minimum acceptable inter-sample agreement before a judgment is considered trustworthy.

fail_fast.description: Whether the orchestrator should abort on the first subject or rule failure.

max_duration_ms.description: Maximum total evaluation duration allowed for this task.

parallel_subjects.description: Whether subjects may be processed in parallel.

metadata.description: Optional task-level metadata for audit and experiment bookkeeping.
